scope: Standard preemptible Modal Functions resource list prices, at displayed per-second precision
cpu_units: One physical core is two AWS/GCP vCPU equivalents according to this pricing page; cpu=8 is an eight-Modal-CPU request, not an eight-AWS-vCPU request. GVisor may expose a different logical CPU topology.
billing_notes: Pricing page meters the larger of requested resources and actual CPU/memory use.
Billable time includes application load, processing inputs and the default post-input idle window (60 seconds unless changed).
Runner elapsed-time estimates exclude image builds, startup outside the timed function, unrecorded idle tails, storage, network, platform fees, credits and discounts; invoice data is unavailable.
Derived hourly values are arithmetic from the displayed per-second prices, not a statement of invoice metering precision.
plan_allowances: Not inferred for this account; credits and included transfer may apply.
